items.q: they take the nice Peter Claibor, the line of the college. Well, the men's college, they had the chartered first, Knights of Peter Claibor

ctx.x: Well, they could be a branch.

There's something like, speaking like in the Catwood religion, you see, they take the nice Peter Claibor, the line of the college. Well, the men's college, they had the chartered first, Knights of Peter Claibor, and then the women's, they fall, they call the ladies auxiliary, Knights of Peter Claibor. Yeah, that's what I was thinking about.
Of course, the Bulls Club isn't like the Knights of Peter Claibor.
